# Cloud and infrastructure

## Scope

Applies when the change touches IaC, containers, Kubernetes, functions, IAM, or cloud cost. Not when the change only reads configuration the platform already provides. Neighbours: `aidd-team:ci-pipeline`, `aidd-team:release-rollout`, `aidd-team:enterprise-controls`.

## Standards

| # | Standard | Edition | Checked | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S1 | The host's Well-Architected framework or reference architectures | AWS 2024-11-06; Google Cloud 2026-01-28; Cloudflare 2026-06-05; Azure, living | 2026-10-16 | <https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/welcome.html> |
| S2 | FinOps Framework: budgets, allocation by tags, and unit cost | FinOps Framework 2026 | 2026-10-16 | <https://www.finops.org/framework/> |
| S3 | CIS Benchmarks | — | 2026-10-16 (reviewed) | <https://www.cisecurity.org/cis-benchmarks> |
| S4 | Kubernetes Pod Security Standards: workloads at the `restricted` Pod Security profile | — | 2026-10-16 (reviewed) | <https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/security/pod-security-standards/> |
| S5 | CIS Kubernetes Benchmark | 2.0.1 | 2026-10-16 | <https://www.cisecurity.org/benchmark/kubernetes> |
| S6 | Policy as code (Open Policy Agent, Kyverno) | — | 2026-10-16 | <https://www.openpolicyagent.org/docs> |
| S7 | AWS Well-Architected Sustainability Pillar | 2024-11-06 | 2026-10-17 | <https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/sustainability-pillar/sustainability-pillar.html> |
| S8 | Software Carbon Intensity (SCI) | SCI 1.1.0; ISO/IEC 21031:2024 | 2026-10-22 | <https://sci.greensoftware.foundation/> |

## Checklist by loop step

| Step | Item | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Before the first edit (`aidd gate --paths`) | CI/CD files are protected paths (major, the security pool). IaC, containers, and Kubernetes manifests match the baseline risk rules `baseline:iac` and `baseline:containers` (normal) unless a dimension, a risk rule, or a protected path raises them. | S1 |
| Before the first edit (`aidd gate --paths`) | An IAM change or new network exposure (a public bucket, an open port) declares the security dimension (major). | S3, S6 |
| Specify | The plan or dry-run output is in the Acceptance; blast radius and rollback (previous version, previous state) are named. | S1 |
| Specify | A stateful service (database, bucket, queue holding data) states its RTO and RPO, and has a restore runbook (`restore: true`, `rto`, `rpo`). A person runs it as a restore drill from real backups into a scratch environment. `aidd doctor` warns when `tested_on` passes `docs.max_runbook_age_days`. | S1 |
| Specify | Placement (functions, containers, VMs, edge) chosen with references/cost-and-performance.md. A monthly estimate at today's load and at 10x, in the Context or the tech spec's Scale and cost row, within `project.budget`. `aidd validate` warns on none, or one over `max_infra_per_month`. | S1, S2 |
| Specify | Sustainability: idle environments scale to zero, region and instance type weigh carbon beside cost where the provider publishes it, and a Spec with a carbon target reports SCI per functional unit. | S7, S8 |
| Implement | Least privilege on every identity; no long-lived secret (OIDC); images pinned by digest, and their signatures checked at admission where the platform can. | S3, S4, S6 |
| Implement | Allocation tags (environment, service, owner) on every resource. Where the IaC defines cloud resources: a budget with an alert per environment, and non-production that scales to zero. A concurrency or instance cap on every function and autoscaler, and pooled database connections. | S2, S1 |
| Review | The plan matches the Spec: no resource deleted or replaced, and no cost increase, that the Spec did not name. | S6, S2 |
| Roll out | Progressive rollout (canary or blue-green) with automatic rollback on the SLO where the host supports it, otherwise the rollback runbook. A drift check after apply; actual cost by tag against the estimate in the observe window, an unexplained gap a Learn action. | S1, S2 |

## Test commands

| Command | Proves | How | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| IaC scanning | no high finding in the infrastructure code | `uvx checkov==3.3.20 -d .`, a Trivy config scan, or KICS | S3 |
| Policy as code | the plan or manifests pass the policies | the `policy-tool`'s tests entry, such as `conftest test` over OPA policies, or Kyverno | S6 |
| Manifest lint | Pod Security Standards and best practices hold | `kube-linter lint .` (kube-linter v0.8.3) or Polaris | S4, S5 |
| Plan or dry-run check | no resource is destroyed or replaced that the Spec did not name | a script over `terraform show -json`, `pulumi preview --json` (Pulumi v3.265.0), `npx aws-cdk@2.1143.0 diff --fail`, or `npx wrangler@4.148.0 deploy --dry-run` failing on an unnamed destroy or replace; the plan attached for the Approver | S1 |
| Cost diff threshold | the cost change is what the Spec states; the total is within `max_infra_per_month` | Optional: the `cost-estimate-tool`'s tests entry, such as Infracost's `scan <dir> --json` on base and head failing when `summary.total_monthly_cost` passes the Spec's change or limit, or the provider's calculator. Infracost sends resource parameters to its pricing API or a self-hosted `INFRACOST_CLI_PRICING_ENDPOINT` | S2 |
| Tag and budget policy | every resource has the allocation tags; each environment, a budget with an alert | For Terraform or OpenTofu: the `policy-tool`'s tests entry over `terraform show -json`, denying an untagged resource and an environment without a budget | S2, S6 |
| IAM and exposure check | no wildcard action on a wildcard resource, no public principal, no admin port open to the internet | the `policy-tool`'s rules over the `iac-tool`'s plan | S6, S3 |

- From `aidd-team:enterprise-controls`: Container scan and SBOM.

- Build provenance (SLSA) and the pipeline that produces it: `aidd-team:ci-pipeline`.
- A published project's OpenSSF Scorecard and OSPS Baseline: `aidd-team:package-publishing`.

## Keep it current

Each entry is due after its `review_every_days` (else emerging 90 days, established 365) or by its `review_due`. An emerging one applies only when the change needs it, said in the Spec. One `aidd eval standards` lists as due is looked up in Specify, and a missing one is proposed to aidd's `schemas/industry-standards.json`.
